answer.reason: Assyria's story rests on two defining events, the captivity of Israel and the destruction of Sennacherib's host, which the verses state plainly.

clauses.english: took Samaria and carried Israel away captive
clauses.quote: took Samaria, and carried Israel away into Assyria

clauses.english: lost 185,000 of its army in one night to the angel of the LORD
clauses.quote: the angel of the LORD went out, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians

doubts: Most marked verses speak of the kings of Assyria (Pul, Tiglathpileser, Shalmaneser, Sennacherib) and are treated as events of the land and its kingdom.
GEN 10:11 names Asshur as a man who built Nineveh, and some other verses (Ezekiel 23, Hosea) use Assyria figuratively; none of these were used.
